nodes.description: Boolean flag _mintingFinished controlling whether new tokens may be minted
Boolean flag _transferEnabled controlling whether token transfers are allowed for non-operators
Owner address stored by Ownable, used by onlyOwner access control
Maximum total supply cap set by ERC20Capped
libcoin.mint(address,uint256): restricted minter function that mints new tokens while minting is not finished
transfer(address,uint256) overridden with canTransfer gate on msg.sender
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) overridden with canTransfer gate on from address
finishMinting(): owner-only function that permanently stops minting
enableMinting(): owner-only function that clears the minting-finished flag
enableTransfer(): owner-only function that turns on transfers
ERC1363 transferAndCall(address,uint256,bytes): transfers tokens then calls receiver callback
ERC1363 transferFromAndCall(address,address,uint256,bytes): transfers and then calls receiver callback
ERC1363 approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes): approves spender then calls spender callback
Internal helper that performs the external onTransferReceived callback on the recipient contract
Internal helper that performs the external onApprovalReceived callback on the spender contract
TokenRecover.recoverERC20(address,uint256): owner-only recovery of ERC20 tokens sent to the contract
Hook in ERC20/ERC20Capped invoked before every transfer, mint and burn
Internal ERC20._transfer that mutates balances and emits Transfer
Internal ERC20._mint that increases totalSupply and recipient balance
Internal ERC20._burn that decreases supply and holder balance
Caller address used for role and ownership checks and as callback operator
External call IERC1363Receiver(to).onTransferReceived on an untrusted recipient contract after state changes
External call IERC1363Spender(spender).onApprovalReceived on an untrusted spender contract
Low-level recipient.call{value:amount} used by Address.sendValue
staticcall used by ERC165Checker._callERC165SupportsInterface on an arbitrary account
Parameter to of the mint function, destination of newly minted tokens
Parameter value of the mint function, amount of tokens to mint
Parameter to of the transfer function, recipient of the tokens
Parameter value of the transfer function, amount to transfer
Parameter from of transferFrom, source of the tokens and canTransfer subject
Parameter to of transferFrom, recipient of the tokens
Parameter value of transferFrom, amount to transfer
Parameter data of transferAndCall passed to the receiver callback
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, target of approval and callback
Parameter tokenAddress of recoverERC20, ERC20 contract to recover from
Parameter tokenAmount of recoverERC20, amount of tokens to recover

edges.reason: mint uses onlyMinter, verifying msg.sender holds MINTER_ROLE before minting
finishMinting is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to msg.sender
enableMinting is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to msg.sender
enableTransfer is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _owner to msg.sender
recoverERC20 is guarded by onlyOwner and sends tokens to owner()
transfer is gated by canTransfer(_msgSender()) requiring transfer enabled or OPERATOR role
transferFrom is gated by canTransfer(from) requiring transfer enabled or OPERATOR role on from
mint delegates token creation to ERC20._mint
transfer delegates balance mutation to ERC20._transfer
transferFrom delegates balance mutation to ERC20._transfer
transferAndCall first performs transfer, moving tokens to the recipient
transferAndCall invokes _checkAndCallTransfer to trigger the receiver callback
transferFromAndCall first performs transferFrom moving tokens
transferFromAndCall invokes _checkAndCallTransfer to trigger the receiver callback
approveAndCall invokes _checkAndCallApprove to trigger the spender callback
_checkAndCallTransfer makes an external callback to an untrusted recipient contract after balances are updated
_checkAndCallApprove makes an external callback to an untrusted spender contract after allowance is set
The onTransferReceived callback can reenter transfer before the outer call completes
The onApprovalReceived callback can reenter approveAndCall/approve flows
_transfer invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
_mint invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook for cap enforcement
mint parameter to flows into the minted account
mint parameter value flows into the minted amount
transfer parameter to flows into the transfer recipient
transfer parameter value flows into the transferred amount
transferFrom parameter from flows into canTransfer check and _transfer source
transferFrom parameter to flows into the transfer recipient
transferFrom parameter value flows into the transferred amount
transferAndCall parameter data flows into the receiver callback payload
approveAndCall parameter spender flows into approve and the spender callback
recoverERC20 parameter tokenAddress is used for the external IERC20 transfer call
recoverERC20 parameter tokenAmount is used for the external IERC20 transfer call
